preconditions.description: The input contains at least one line (T).
Each test case line contains exactly two space-separated strings S and P.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.isalpha() for c in s) and all(c.isalpha() for c in p) for line in stdin.strip().splitlines()[1:] for s, p in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: S and P consist only of alphabetic characters.
The number of test cases T is between 1 and 250.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 60 and 1 <= len(p) <= 60 for line in stdin.strip().splitlines()[1:] for s, p in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Lengths of S and P are between 1 and 60.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['Possible', 'Impossible'] for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'Possible' or 'Impossible'.

postconditions.expression: all((len(p) == 2 * len(s) and any(p == s[:i] + s + s[i:] for i in range(len(s) + 1))) == (line == 'Possible') for line, (s, p) in zip(stdout.strip().splitlines(), [line.split() for line in stdin.strip().splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'Possible' if and only if P has length 2*|S| and P can be formed by inserting S into S at some position; otherwise it is 'Impossible'.
